{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 插件：为 dsh-better-sidebar 添加 SVN 源代码管理 Tab——status/diff/log/commit/update/revert/冲突解决，与内置 Git 面板对称，纯 svn CLI（--xml 输出）驱动，git 直装免构建","id":"gh:1337923700","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-better-sidebar-svn","slug":"ztyhehe/dsh-better-sidebar-svn","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-better-sidebar","dsh-plugin","svn"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 插件：为 dsh-better-sidebar 添加 SVN 源代码管理 Tab——status/diff/log/commit/update/revert/冲突解决，与内置 Git 面板对称"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"，纯 svn CLI（--xml 输出）驱动，git 直装免构建"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-better-sidebar-svn"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"为 DSH-better-sidebar 添加 **SVN（Subversion）源代码管理面板**的插件。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## ✨ 功能"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **📊 状态面板**：变更分「已暂存 / 未暂存」两段显示（修改/添加/删除/冲突/未版本控制等）
